name: How high should a kitchen backsplash go on the wall?

mainEntity.name: How high should a kitchen backsplash go on the wall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Backsplash tile should generally be installed up to the bottom of upper wall cabinets, but open-concept walls offer multiple design options. In areas without upper cabinetry, such as around a chimney-style range hood or over a sink window, bringing the tile all the way to the ceiling creates a dramatic focal point. For walls that end before the cabinetry does, align the tile with the edge of the upper cabinet or the countertop corner, finishing exposed edges with a metal edge trim or bullnose tile for a clean termination.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tile typically runs from the countertop to the bottom of the upper cabinets, but running tile to the ceiling behind floating shelves or range hoods creates a bold focal point.
